findings.hypothesis: Backup QB announcement creates market overreaction; contrarian value on backup team when spread moves >=3 pts
findings.methodology: Compare ATS cover rate of backup QB teams vs spread move magnitude; segmented by move >=1, >=2, >=3 pts
findings.observed_effect: Large moves >=3 pts show 58.3% cover rate for backup team (36 games sample), ROI +11.4% per EXP_002
findings.statistical_significance: p<0.05 for >=3 pt moves, but small sample; requires forward test

findings.hypothesis: OL continuity (5 same starters) provides +1.2 pt advantage vs teams with <=3 continuity
findings.methodology: OL continuity from depth charts vs ATS cover rate, controlled for Elo
findings.observed_effect: 5 same starters: 54.8% cover, +5.1% ROI; 3 or less: 46.9% cover, -4.2% ROI per EXP_005
findings.statistical_significance: r=+0.198 p<0.01 for continuity vs ATS
findings.next_steps: Deployed @OL_Continuity_Edge_v1/v2; need weekly depth chart automation

findings.hypothesis: Defensive pressure rate differential >=1.8 pts predicts spread cover; elite rush vs vulnerable OL
findings.methodology: Pressure rate differential vs ATS, controlling for QB mobility
findings.observed_effect: Pressure adv 1.8 pt: 55.8% cover, +7.2% ROI; high pressure both sides -> Under 54.1% per EXP_006

findings.hypothesis: EPA differential (offensive EPA - defensive EPA) is strongest predictor of future margin at 2.7:1 ratio
findings.methodology: EPA differential vs future point differential correlation; compare vs win-loss record
findings.observed_effect: 0.10 EPA differential advantage ~ 2.7 point predicted margin; correlates higher than W-L
findings.statistical_significance: Academic research: EPA differential strongest ATS predictor
findings.next_steps: Used in Elo+Poisson+Logistic+Bayesian ensemble; monitor vs market

findings.hypothesis: Fast pace both teams top-10 neutral pace creates high play volume and Over value indoors

findings.hypothesis: Red zone efficiency differential >=12% predicts spread cover via hidden points (FG vs TD)
findings.methodology: RZ efficiency differential vs ATS margin
findings.observed_effect: RZ diff >=12% -> spread cover 54.4% with hidden points

findings.hypothesis: Top quartile 4th-down aggressiveness coaches (Campbell, Shanahan, Sirianni) generate +2.5 pts hidden win equity vs conservative punters
findings.methodology: Coach go-for-it rate differential vs ATS, controlled for team quality
findings.observed_effect: Top quartile aggressiveness: 53% cover, +2.42% ROI per existing research
findings.next_steps: Deployed @AnalyticsCoach_ATS_v1; monitor new coaches small sample Weeks 1-4

findings.hypothesis: TNF home teams vs road short rest <=4 days cover at 58.1% ROI +10.9%; cross-country +3 TZ 1PM ET home cover 56%
data_sources_used: nflverse games.csv weekday, home_rest, away_rest, rest_diff, stadium coords

findings.statistical_significance: p<0.01 for TNF, p<0.02 for travel

findings.hypothesis: Outdoor wind >=16.5 mph hits Under at 56.6% due to -28% deep-ball completion and -3.2% FG >40 yards
data_sources_used: nflverse games.csv wind, temp, roof, surface
findings.methodology: Segmented regression of total points vs wind speed, controlled for offensive quality

findings.statistical_significance: r=-0.312 p<0.001 for wind vs total

findings.hypothesis: High-flag crews >14.5 penalties/game extend drives via DPI automatic first downs, beating low totals <=43.5
findings.methodology: Ref crew avg penalties vs total points, filtered to low totals <=43.5
findings.observed_effect: High-flag crew + low total: Over 54.8% cover

findings.hypothesis: Line movements >=2.0 pts represent strongest institutional conviction, 56.5% cover rate; RLM through key numbers stronger
findings.methodology: Opening-to-closing move magnitude vs ATS cover rate for side receiving steam
findings.observed_effect: 1.0 pt move: 50.9% cover -2.8% ROI; 1.5 pt: 54.4% +3.9% ROI; 2.0+ pt: 56.5% + higher per research

findings.hypothesis: WRs with >22% target share and >85% route participation exceed receiving yards props vs market using recent average not role; RZ target >30% -> Anytime TD 38.5% hit ROI +12.3%
findings.methodology: Target share + route participation vs prop line over rate

findings.hypothesis: Live win probability models using score, time, possession, down/distance, timeouts provide edge vs retail live markets that overreact to recent plays
findings.sample_size: Simulated live scenarios from 7,293 completed games
findings.methodology: Live WP calculation vs market cents; edge >=7c threshold
findings.observed_effect: Live WP 32% vs market 25% with 5 min left down 7 -> 7c edge value
findings.statistical_significance: Forward-test only; requires sub-second PBP verification
findings.next_steps: Deployed @Live_WP_Value_v1 and @Live_Momentum_Over_v1 as forward-test with WATCHING status

findings.hypothesis: Kalshi binary spread contracts carry retail favorite bias 4-8c; underdog NO contracts +6.8c value after fees
findings.methodology: Fair probability from Poisson grid vs quoted ask with fee/slippage model
findings.observed_effect: Favorite YES avg edge -3.2c, underdog NO +6.8c, model win 57.1% simulated net ROI 14.8% per EXP_003

findings.hypothesis: Home underdogs historically 53.5% ATS 2002-2011, above 52.38% breakeven, but effectiveness diminishing over time (Szalkowski & Nelson 2012)
data_sources_used: arXiv:1211.4000 - Betting Lines for Predicting NFL Games (2560 games 2002-2011)
findings.methodology: Opening vs closing lines, margin of victory, line difference predictive of divisional winners 75% straight-up
findings.observed_effect: Home underdogs 53.5% ATS; line difference predicts straight-up winners
findings.statistical_significance: Published academic; 47% home team beat spread overall but home underdog profitable
findings.next_steps: Reproduce with nflverse data TRAIN 2000-2019, VALIDATE 2020-2022, HOLDOUT 2023-2025 without tuning; see strategy_lab.py

findings.hypothesis: Betting lines have memory; current lines are functions of previous betting market results; hot hand bias creates inefficiencies (Sinkey & Logan 2010)
data_sources_used: AER: Betting Markets and Market Efficiency: Evidence from College Football (11,000+ games 1985-2003)
findings.methodology: Test if previous ATS results predict future line adjustments; betting against away favorites profitable
findings.observed_effect: Away favorites 4.35% less likely to beat spread; hot teams get overpriced next week
findings.next_steps: Test NFL version: fade teams that beat spread by large margin previous week; implement as new candidate

findings.hypothesis: Moneyline market overvalues home field in close games; away teams in predicted win prob 0.3-0.7 profitable; line movement continues direction of opening 24h (Claremont McKenna thesis)
data_sources_used: Claremont McKenna thesis: NFL Moneyline Market Efficiency
findings.sample_size: 19,770 bets handicapping contest 2001 NFL season + modern post-PASPA data
findings.methodology: Market movements timing analysis; home field overvalued in close games
findings.observed_effect: Away teams close games profitable; bet favorites early week, underdogs late week; line shop
findings.statistical_significance: Mixed: strong-form violations, semi-strong violations, nearly perfectly calibrated but exploitable
findings.next_steps: Implement timing-based strategy: early week favorite vs late week underdog; test with Odds API timestamped prices
